title: Circuit Claims Depend on What Is Extracted and How It Is Compared
abstract: arXiv:2607.18921v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Circuit extraction identifies model components whose presence preserves a target behavior under ablation, but preserving behavior does not single out one circuit. We study this in a synthetic Lean tactic-prediction benchmark with fixed proof rules and randomized surface form. Across dense and weight-sparse checkpoints of the same transformer, evaluated on atomic and compositional proofs, we vary which extracted object is reported: a compact prediction-preserving circuit, a broader graph retaining surrounding read, write, and routing structure, or a subgraph extracted with a post-ablation loss budget. First, overlap between groups of component-to-component connections is low, sometimes close to a random baseline. Overlap is much higher for selected attention-head sets under deterministic selection, but falls sharply when selection among equally scored heads is randomized. translated_title: 电路归因结论取决于提取什么以及如何比较
translated_abstract: 电路提取旨在识别在消融实验下其存在能够保持目标行为的模型组件，但仅仅保持行为并不能唯一确定一个电路。我们在一个具有固定证明规则和随机化表面形式的合成 Lean 战术预测基准上研究这一问题。在同一个 transformer 的稠密与权重稀疏检查点上，分别在原子证明和组合证明上进行评估，我们改变了所报告的提取对象：紧凑的预测保持电路、保留周围读取、写入和路由结构的更广泛图，或使用消融后损失预算提取的子图。首先，不同组件间连接组之间的重叠度很低，有时接近随机基线。在确定性选择下，所选注意力头集合的重叠度要高得多，但当在得分相同的注意力头之间进行随机选择时，重叠度急剧下降。其次，各条件的归一化图大小排序……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文通过在 Lean 战术预测基准上的系统实验表明，可解释性研究中“电路”的结论高度依赖于提取对象的定义和比较方法——不同提取方式得到的电路重叠度很低，说明行为保持并不能唯一确定一个电路。
en_tdlr: Circuit extraction claims in interpretability depend heavily on what is extracted and how circuits are compared: different extraction methods yield circuits with low overlap, showing that behavior preservation does not uniquely determine a circuit.
